theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (F : Set (Euclid P)), R.Represents X → IsClosed F → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (F) → X ω = 0) → R.measure Fᶜ = 0 ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → F ⊆ W → X.mass ≤ X.massOn W
